move: sun morphs to cloud, rain, snow, storm; card colour and temperature follow
how: A blue card holds an SVG with a white body path (sun), eight ray lines, precipitation lines/circles, a bolt, a temperature and a label. Every D/5 (from 0.12D) the body morphSVGs SUN to CLOUD to CLOUD_LOW (power3.inOut, 0.7s), the rays scale/fade out (power2.in) or in (back.out(2), staggered), the card backgroundColor crossfades over 0.8s, the temperature counts (power2.out), and the label drops out and rises in via a callback swap. During rain, drops fall y -6 to 16 on repeating 0.45s power1.in tweens; snow flakes drift down with sideways x on sine; storm pops the bolt in with back.out(3) and flickers it. Rays rotate 90 degrees per loop (symmetric, seamless) and the body drifts x 0 to 4 on sine yoyo.
adapt: Change STATES (label, degrees, background colour, body path), the city string and the H/L/Wind row; keep 0.7s morphs and the step = D / states.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the card and builds rays/drops/flakes; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with STEP = D / states.length. Scope '#body', '#rays', '#lab', '#deg', '#card', '#bolt' to el.
caveats: the last state's morph and label swap run to ~7.25s, past D=7, so the loop cuts the return to Sunny slightly
label text changes in a callback and does not reverse on backward scrub
repeat-based rain/snow tweens use immediateRender:false and must keep it
